beats.intent: First contact. The line opens mid-thought, as if the Society has been drafting this message for years and the channel was expensive to reopen. Address the recipient only as 'the author of record'. Do not yet explain who you are. End on an instruction to keep reading.
beats.fallbackText: —and after considerable internal deliberation, the Committee has elected to reopen this channel. You are the author of record. Confirm nothing yet. Simply keep reading.

beats.intent: Identify yourselves as the Esteemed Storyteller's Society, registrars and restorers of damaged narratives. Cite file 7,349-Dusk: the registered work 'The Thorbata Chronicles, Vol. I: Early Dusk', recovered by field agents after long neglect, in a condition you decline to describe over an open line. Close with the Society's motto-like reproach: the Society does not neglect stories, even when their authors do.
beats.fallbackText: This is the Esteemed Storyteller's Society. File 7,349-Dusk. Registered title: The Thorbata Chronicles, Vol. I: Early Dusk. Status: abandoned by its author; recovered by our field agents in a condition we decline to describe over an open line. The Society does not neglect stories. Even when their authors do.

beats.text: Before anything else, for the record: are you, or are you not, the author?

options.label: I don't know what you're talking about.

beats.intent: React once, briefly, to the author's exact words — dry if they confirmed, withering if they deflected, unmoved if they denied (the register does not depend on their cooperation). Then state that validation is required regardless: not for the Society's sake, for the book's. They must answer as its author, even where memory is water-stained.
beats.fallbackText: Noted. Your answer changes less than you think — the register does not depend on your cooperation. The damage, however, is extensive, and validation is required. Not for us. For the book. Answer as its author, even where memory is water-stained.

beats.text: How many pages did Early Dusk have, at its fullest?
And at its center — a hero, a heroine, or someone the book refused to name?

options.label: Someone the book refused to name

beats.intent: This reply arrives a beat too soon, as if the Society answered before the author finished choosing. Cite the claimed page count back at them from the recovered facts: of the pages they claim, forty-one survive. Acknowledge their answer about the one at the center in the tone of a registrar updating a ledger that has stopped arguing.
beats.fallbackText: Forty-one pages survive. Whatever number you remember, that is what remains. The one at the center is entered in the register precisely as you say. The register does not argue. Not anymore.

beats.text: Four chapter headings are still legible. Which one feels like yours?

options.label: The Wolf at the Manor Door
options.factValue: The Wolf at the Manor Door

beats.text: A practical matter. The tavern called The Eel and the Seagull — what was its famous dish? The menu is water-damaged and the archivists are quarreling.

options.label: Whatever Brannic wasn't caught smuggling that week
options.factValue: whatever Brannic wasn't caught smuggling that week

writeEvidence.textTemplate: Menu fragment, water-damaged, consistent with the author's claim: {{answer}}.

beats.intent: Mid-message pause, as if checking something. The archive has just produced a menu fragment — water-damaged but legible where it matters — and it agrees with the author's claim. Report this with faint suspicion, as though the book adjusted itself to agree. Note that the archivists have gone quiet; they do not like it when the book agrees this quickly.
beats.fallbackText: A moment. …The archive has produced a menu fragment. Water-damaged, but legible where it matters — and it agrees with you. The archivists have gone quiet. They do not like it when the book agrees this quickly.

beats.text: Last question of the ritual. Where did you write it? The book remembers a window, but not the country.

options.label: A room on a Greek island

beats.intent: Now the true reason for contact, stated plainly and quickly: Ilan Voss, senior storyteller of the Society, entered the book to find the hero the author left in it. His last message reached the Society seven days ago, from beneath a tavern called The Eel and the Seagull, in Jhinuka Docks. Since then, nothing. The book is too damaged to reach him from the Society's side; it will have to be repaired from the author's.
beats.fallbackText: Now the reason we write. Ilan Voss, senior storyteller of this Society, entered your book to find the hero you left in it. His last message reached us seven days ago, from beneath a tavern called The Eel and the Seagull, in Jhinuka Docks. Since then: nothing. The book is too damaged to reach him from our side. It will have to be repaired from yours.

writeEvidence.textTemplate: Field agent Ilan Voss, senior storyteller, entered the damaged narrative to locate the missing hero. Last transmission: seven days ago, from beneath The Eel and the Seagull, Jhinuka Docks.

beats.intent: After a silence of days, brisk logistics: a parcel is en route — oilcloth, paper seals. It contains a field typewriter, page clamps, and what remains of Early Dusk. Sign nothing, tell no one, and whatever the weather does: do not open it indoors.
beats.fallbackText: A parcel is en route to you. Oilcloth, paper seals. It contains a field typewriter, page clamps, and what remains of Early Dusk. Sign nothing. Tell no one. And whatever the weather does — do not open it indoors.

beats.intent: Final instruction, quieter than everything before it: the author is to go back to the place where the book was written — cite their claimed writing place from the recovered facts — at early evening. They will know the hour when the light turns the color of the title. Close with the Society's cold courtesy: it thanks them for their cooperation, and regrets that it must.
beats.fallbackText: Go back to where you wrote it. You know the place. Early evening. You will know the hour when the light turns the color of the title. The Society thanks you for your cooperation. It regrets that it must.
